tasks.Identify_Gift_Status: Determine the cost status of a gift given as a free item.

Questions.content: What is the definition of "cost status" in this context, and how does it relate to the answer choices provided?

Answers.content:
In this context, "cost status" refers to whether the gift has an associated cost or not. Specifically, it would determine if the item was given as a freebie (no cost) or if there was some form of payment involved.

Given the answer choices provided:
(a) deadly - This does not relate to cost.
(b) imprisoned - Also unrelated to cost.
(c) paid for - Indicates the item had an associated cost.
(d) expensive - Describes the price level, but not the status itself.
(e) in prison - Unrelated to cost.

The correct answer choice would be (c) paid for, as it indicates that there was no payment involved, making the gift free.
